title: yatsude effect
description: What a unit or a flow does outside reading. Risky effects (push, open-mr, merge, post, tracker-write, release, deploy, delete, install, kill) must each be guarded by a stop or covered by the charter.

x-meaning.write-files: writes its own files (reports, run folders, worktrees it creates and removes)
x-meaning.spawn: starts subagents, headless workers or scheduled checks
x-meaning.browser: drives a controlled browser (never the user's own)
x-meaning.open-mr: opens or edits a merge request or pull request
x-meaning.merge: merges a merge request or pull request
x-meaning.post: publishes text under the user's name (comments, messages, descriptions)
x-meaning.tracker-write: changes a ticket: status, labels, fields, assignee, description
x-meaning.release: cuts a release or a tag
x-meaning.delete: deletes or closes something it did not create
